intro: The Horn of Awakening is a sounding instrument kept in a chest by Kerlonian Evershade in southern Darkshore. It is used to rouse the drowsy druid whenever he collapses into a slumber on the road to Ashenvale.

p: Kerlonian Evershade, a Druid of the Claw recently awoken from centuries inside the Emerald Dream, finds himself persistently lethargic in the waking realm. Journeying south toward Maestra's Post, he entrusts this horn to travelers willing to escort him. Whenever exhaustion overtakes him along the perilous wilderness trail, a clear blast from the instrument jolts his senses, prodding him back to his feet before wild beasts or cultists can seize upon his slumber.
